title: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A planeswalker and bonder of monsters via the eludha, a former captain of the Specials, who is corrupted after bonding with a Phyrexian centaur hulk and ends up compleated.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker with glowing green tattoos who fights beside Lukka and flees when he turns Phyrexian.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A white-haired planeswalker who keeps flickering in and out of the plane as she tries to remain stable.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Phyrexian elf with a bladed arm and copper cord hair who spars joyfully with Vorinclex and takes Lukka under her command.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A twelve-foot Phyrexian praetor of the Hunter Maze, recovered from his journey to Kaldheim.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The telepath who recruited Lukka for the mission.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who reportedly could barely handle Vorinclex alone.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler whose stronghold is the team's target.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker whose reputation for swearing is used as a comparison.

entities.name: Phyrexian centaur hulk
entities.description: A four-legged Phyrexian construct that Lukka dominates through the eludha and later merges with.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane the strike team has invaded.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: Lukka's home plane, which Phyrexia threatens.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: A place connected to Lukka's past deeds.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane Vorinclex recently journeyed to.

entities.name: Hunter Maze
entities.description: A canopy of oily metal-and-flesh trees in New Phyrexia that Vorinclex rules.

entities.name: The eludha
entities.description: Lukka's ability to forge a bond with a creature's mind and dominate it.

entities.name: The Coppercoats
entities.description: A group in which Lukka once had a great sparring match.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde that rules New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Lukka arrives in the wrong location on New Phyrexia, separated from the strike team, and recalls why he joined the mission.
events.quote: He wasn't with the rest of the strike team.

events.summary: Lukka decides to climb a tree in the Hunter Maze rather than planeswalk, hoping to dominate a creature to chart a route.
events.quote: No, he'd go high, try to make it back to the others.

events.summary: Lukka follows an angry cry and finds Nissa and the Wanderer fighting a Phyrexian construct on a bough.
events.quote: Lukka had seen them before: Nissa, and the woman was called . . . the Wanderer.

events.summary: Lukka uses the eludha to freeze a second Phyrexian creeping above them, saving Nissa and the Wanderer from an ambush.
events.quote: Lukka reached out with the eludha, the bond he could forge between himself and another creature.

events.summary: The Wanderer decapitates the first creature, then vanishes with a flicker of light.
events.quote: Then, with a strange flicker of light, the Wanderer vanished.

events.summary: Lukka proposes using the dominated Phyrexian as a guide and Nissa reluctantly agrees after he promises to kill it at any sign of trouble.
events.quote: if I get so much as a stomachache, I'll end the creature.

events.summary: Lukka and Nissa ride the centaur hulk up a tree, with Lukka irritated by Nissa's heels and recalling a childhood beating.
The Wanderer warns them of a Phyrexian monstrosity that attacks Nissa; the centaur hulk wraps wires around Lukka's spine and he kills the attacker with his harpoon.
events.quote: Veiny wires sprouted from its torso, plunging through his skin and wiggling through his gut to wrap around his spine.

events.summary: Intrusive thoughts begin whispering power and strength to Lukka as they climb higher through the canopy.
events.quote: You deserve power. You are strong. Here, strength is rewarded. The weak are culled.

events.summary: Lukka discovers Phyrexian rootlets still inside him, and instead of fear feels healthier and stronger.
events.quote: He felt healthier, stronger, more confident

events.summary: The group is attacked by leech-like creatures and a mother-beast; Lukka frees his Phyrexian by slicing through the mother-monstrosity with his now-metallic hands.
events.quote: He pulled apart a lip of flesh and freed his Phyrexian.

events.summary: Lukka notices a maggot-like wriggling and metal under a scab on his arm and feels no pain.
events.quote: A bone-deep wound, he marveled, and it didn't even hurt.

events.summary: The Wanderer reveals Vorinclex is nearby and recovered from his journey to Kaldheim, and Lukka and Nissa decide to attack him.
events.quote: We need to take him down before he hurts anyone else.

events.summary: At the center of the maze they find Vorinclex sparring joyfully with Glissa.
events.quote: Vorinclex fought a Phyrexian elf beneath the monstrous skulls that hung from the ceiling.

events.summary: Lukka charges in against Glissa while Nissa fights Vorinclex.
events.quote: Without another word, Lukka charged in.

events.summary: Lukka merges with the Phyrexian centaur hulk, gaining a second set of arms and compleating.
Nissa, horrified, backs away as Lukka advances on her, and the Wanderer flickers in to shield her and tells her to run.
Glissa takes command of Lukka, ordering him to find but not kill Nissa, and Lukka sets out hunting.
events.quote: Find the elf, Lukka. But do not kill her.

relations.note: he stops and waits for her orders after compleation
relations.quote: Lukka stopped, waiting for further instruction.
She would not let an ally face combat alone.

relations.note: they spar together as joyous companions
he bonds with and dominates it via the eludha
relations.quote: Lukka reached out with the eludha
that's how he'd risen to captaincy of the Specials.

relations.note: his empire is based on the Hunter Maze
